# Nitesh Chawda

> The personal career portfolio of Nitesh Chawda, based in Melbourne, Australia. It describes his professional experience in strategy, enterprise transformation and emerging technology; it is not an agency service catalogue.

## Career and approach

- [Home](https://niteshchawda.consulting/): career overview and selected work across strategy, AI, cybersecurity and quantum technology.
- [My story](https://niteshchawda.consulting/about.html): career journey and education.
- [Career profile](https://niteshchawda.consulting/profile.html): professional experience, concurrent appointments and education.
- [My approach](https://niteshchawda.consulting/services.html): a personal eight-stage method, from education and business case to delivery and scale.
- [Selected work](https://niteshchawda.consulting/engagements.html): professional experience and selected cases.
- [Education and ideas](https://niteshchawda.consulting/insights.html): academic studies and research.
- [Contact](https://niteshchawda.consulting/contact.html): career conversations, speaking and professional connections.

## Academic cases

- [Quantum commercialisation](https://niteshchawda.consulting/quantum-commercialisation.html): an academic proposal, not a claim of delivered commercial outcomes.
- [Investment and performance](https://niteshchawda.consulting/investment-and-performance.html): a Harvard academic case study.

## Interpretation

Named organisations describe employment, contracted engagements, education or other expressly identified relationships. Logos are not endorsements. Career-wide outcome figures include contributions within broader teams and may overlap. Academic proposals and modelled benefits are distinct from delivered professional outcomes. Refer to the linked page for relationship context and qualifications.

This optional file provides a concise reading guide; it is not an access policy or a claim of improved search rankings.
